proof_body:
by
  intro f hq hi a hc
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 hc (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have ha : a < a + δ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨q, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn ha
  obtain ⟨u, hu, h3, h4⟩ := exists_irrational_btwn ha
  have b1 := h (x := (q : ℝ)) (by rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
  have b2 := h (x := u) (by rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
  rw [hq, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at b1
  rw [hi u hu, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at b2
  linarith [b1.1, b1.2, b2.1, b2.2]
target_source: ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ q : ℚ, f (q : ℝ) = 1) → (∀ x : ℝ, Irrational x → f x = 0) → ∀ a : ℝ, ¬ ContinuousAt f a
